files.summary: The component is well-structured with proper loading states and error handling. The main risk is the lack of a screen tag (S-*) and missing export functionality for the offers table, which are critical SaaS completeness requirements. No security or runtime crash issues were found in this client component.

The CollegeDashboardHubPage component is minimal and delegates all logic to DashboardFullScreenHub. The only risk is a potential runtime crash if session.user exists but session.user.role is undefined, which would cause DashboardFullScreenHub to receive an undefined role prop. Additionally, the skeleton loading state lacks a meaningful aria-label for accessibility. No critical security, data, or multi-tenancy issues are present in this thin wrapper component.

This is a static documentation/navigation page with no data fetching, state management, or user input. The code is clean, well-structured, and accessible. The primary risk is the absence of a screen tag (S-*) for SaaS completeness and missing export functionality on a page that is purely informational. No security, runtime, or data integrity issues exist.

issues.message: Screen tag (S-*) is missing. All screens must have a unique screen tag like S-1 for identification and traceability.
issues.suggestion: Add a screen tag constant or comment at the top of the component, e.g., const SCREEN_TAG = 'S-1'; and optionally render it in a hidden element or data attribute.

issues.message: No export functionality is provided for the offers data table. All tabular screens must have an export option (CSV/Excel).
issues.suggestion: Add an export button that calls an API endpoint to download the offers data as CSV or Excel, similar to the existing downloadCsvFromApi pattern.

issues.message: The downloadCollegeOffersTemplate function is called without a try-catch, so if it throws, the error will be unhandled and may crash the page or leave the user without feedback.
issues.suggestion: Wrap the downloadCollegeOffersTemplate call in a try-catch block and show an error toast on failure, similar to downloadAssessmentStarter.

issues.message: session.user.role may be undefined if the session object is incomplete or malformed, causing DashboardFullScreenHub to receive an undefined role prop. This could lead to a crash or incorrect rendering in the child component.
issues.suggestion: Add a fallback or guard for session.user.role before passing it to DashboardFullScreenHub, or handle undefined role inside DashboardFullScreenHub.

issues.message: The skeleton loading state has no aria-label or role='status' for screen readers, making the loading state inaccessible to users relying on assistive technology.
issues.suggestion: Add aria-label='Loading dashboard' and role='status' to the skeleton container for accessibility.

issues.message: Missing screen tag (S-*) on the page. All screens should have a unique identifier for navigation and debugging.
issues.suggestion: Add a screen tag comment or data attribute, e.g., <!-- S-EMP-ASSESSMENT-SUMMARY --> or a hidden span with id='screen-tag'.
